connection.title: Connection
connection.description: The connection is checked before it is accepted. Submit without changes to go back.

data_description.host: IP address of the LAN card.
data_description.password: Saved. Type a new one only to change it.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: The lists are read from the central unit.

data_description.binary_sensors: On when violated: a door open, motion detected. Set what each one is under "Show as" in its entity settings.
data_description.analog_sensors: Set the type and calibration of each under Analog inputs.
data_description.output_sensors: On while the output is switched on. Useful for anything a rule in the central unit mirrors onto an output. Read only; to control an output, pick it under Lights and switches.

lights.title: Excluded resources
lights.description: Step 1 of 4. Pick outputs that drive gates, doors or locks: they will never appear in the lists of lights, switches or valves. If there are none, leave this empty.

lights_lights.title: Lights
lights_lights.description: Step 2 of 4. Lighting outputs to switch on and off. Outputs already used by a valve or read as sensors are not listed.

data_description.select_all: Shows this list again with everything selected, to untick a few.

lights_dimmers.title: Dimmers
lights_dimmers.description: Step 3 of 4. Dimmers, with brightness. Switched on without a brightness, a dimmer gets the central unit's own "on" command, as from NexoVision; a brightness is written as a level.

data_description.select_all: Shows this list again with everything selected, to untick a few.

lights_switches.title: Switches
lights_switches.description: Step 4 of 4. Other outputs to switch on and off, such as a ventilation unit. Outputs picked as lights are not listed.

thermostats.title: Thermostats
thermostats.description: Thermostats to import, each with the thermometer and the range set in the central unit. The next screen asks whether each one heats or cools.

thermostats_direction.title: Heating or cooling
thermostats_direction.description: How each thermostat works is set in the central unit by the sign of its hysteresis: positive (the default) is heating, negative is cooling. The central unit does not report it, so choose here. Heating shows "heating" while the thermostat asks for heat - its output off - and "idle" once the room is warm enough and the output is on.

analog.title: Analog inputs

add_cover.title: Gate or door
add_cover.description: Driven by logic commands: rules in the central unit with an external command condition. Submit an empty form to go back.

data_description.open_command: At most 7 characters. A mistyped command is accepted by the central unit and silently does nothing.
data_description.reed_sensor: Optional. Reads closed or not closed - the only thing that confirms the gate moved. Without it the state is unknown.
data_description.open_only_when_closed: Reads the reed switch right before opening and refuses otherwise. Stops a second open command from halting a gate in motion. Leave it off where stopping part-way is wanted.
data_description.travel_time: Optional. The full travel time plus a margin for communication. Adds a Step button that works like the remote - up, stop, down, stop - and makes toggle do the same. Leave empty to disable.

settings.title: Settings

data_description.interval_inputs: Reed switches and motion sensors, including the gates' reed switches.
data_description.interval_outputs: Watering sections, the main valve and the outputs shown as sensors.
data_description.interval_lights: Lights, dimmers and switches. A change made from Home Assistant shows at once; this interval is for changes made at a wall switch or in another app.
data_description.interval_measurements: Thermometers and analog inputs, which change slowly.

settings.description: Each read takes about 50 ms. After a gate or valve command, the resources that show its effect are read every second for a while, whatever these intervals.

add_valve.title: Valve
add_valve.description: A watering program or anything else started and stopped by a pair of logic commands. Submit an empty form to go back.

data_description.open_command: At most 7 characters. A mistyped command is accepted by the central unit and silently does nothing.
data_description.sections: Optional. The outputs this program switches; the valve is open while any of them is on. Without sections the state is unknown.
data_description.main_valve: Optional. An output that stays on for the whole run: in the pauses between sections the program still counts as running.
data_description.auto_close: Optional. Sends the close command after this time. Runs in Home Assistant and is lost on a restart - if watering must end, give the rule its own duration in the central unit.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the central unit.
error.invalid_auth: The central unit rejected the password.
error.already_configured: Another entry already uses this address.
error.command_empty: The command must not be empty.
error.command_too_long: Logic commands are at most 7 characters.
error.guard_needs_reed_sensor: Needs a reed switch to check.
error.step_needs_unguarded: The Step button needs "Open only when confirmed closed" off: it stops a moving gate with the opposite command.
error.main_valve_is_a_section: The main valve cannot also be one of the sections.
error.unknown_resource: No such resource in the central unit.

abort.cannot_list: Cannot read the resource list from the central unit.
abort.not_loaded: The integration is not running. Fix the connection first.
